headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY YTD
summary: As of July 15, 2026, the portfolio set has demonstrated a strong average return of 19.11%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark, which returned 11.39%. This results in an average alpha of 7.72%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A,' achieved an impressive return of 47.20%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100,' still delivered a respectable return of 12.31%. This outperformance relative to SPY is particularly noteworthy during times of market uncertainty, as it suggests resilience in the portfolio's strategy. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
